subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should OpenClaw support Volcengine Lite UUID-style keys as a first-class route, or keep the current ModelArk API-key route and surface a clearer diagnostic for unsupported key types?
rationale: Current source proves the setup/runtime mismatch can still exist, but the permanent fix depends on an external Volcengine Lite contract and maintainer choice about product support versus diagnostics.

options.title: Add Lite support
options.body: Confirm the Volcengine Lite endpoint/auth requirements, then implement the narrow plugin-owned route with docs and credentialed smoke proof.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the current ModelArk route and make setup/runtime explain when the credential type is unsupported for the selected endpoint.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Document the supported Volcengine credential type and close this as an external plan/key mismatch if maintainers do not want Lite-route support.

recommendation.title: Add Lite support
recommendation.body: Confirm the Volcengine Lite endpoint/auth requirements, then implement the narrow plugin-owned route with docs and credentialed smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, plugin-owned setup behavior, and compatibility-sensitive routing where this history is strongest.
